title: Melakat Autonomous Development and Research
goal: Use Keynu to continuously develop, test, verify, and run research experiments for Melakat while preserving Melakat's scientific contracts, reproducibility, and repository evidence as the domain source of truth.
currentMilestone: Integrate Melakat experiment and repository semantics with Keynu and prove a resumable end-to-end mission
completedMilestones: Melakat Phase Two completed with versioned world, spatial ecology, local resources, movement/sensing primitives, evidence gate, and desktop UI
Melakat Automated Experiment System v1 added for multi-condition, multi-seed headless campaigns
Completed a 90-run local-resource energy sweep with deterministic validation and scientific artifacts
Keynu Engineering Runtime v1 established as the shared software-engineering layer for project integrations
Registered Melakat as a Keynu mission project with a portable KEYNU_PROJECT_ROOT_MELAKAT override
nextMilestones: Implement MelakatDriver domain actions using Engineering Runtime rather than duplicated OS/IO/Git tooling
Validate Melakat experiment specifications and execute controlled headless campaigns through Keynu
Parse Melakat campaign, validation, summary, and comparison artifacts into KAP evidence
Create anomaly and extinction discovery actions that identify runs requiring human/GUI inspection
Prove Keynu can resume a Melakat mission after restart without repeating completed side effects
Use the integration to continue Phase Three research and development
rules: Melakat repository code, world contracts, experiment specifications, tests, and scientific artifacts remain the source of truth for Melakat.
Do not move scientific truth into Keynu mission memory; Keynu stores orchestration state and references to evidence.
Use Keynu Engineering Runtime for filesystem, command, script, Git, build, test, and verification work.
MelakatDriver must contain only Melakat-specific semantics and artifact interpretation.
Preserve the completed Phase One homogeneous baseline and Phase Two evidence contracts when developing later mechanisms.
Use controlled comparisons, multiple seeds, reproducibility checks, and invariant validation for scientific claims.
Do not claim cooperation, competition, adaptation, navigation, or selection beyond what the evidence causally supports.
Prefer headless experiment campaigns for batch science and use the desktop GUI for observation, inspection, and reproduction of interesting runs.
Do not silently alter ancestor genomes or experimental rules merely to produce visually interesting behavior.
Continue through safe verified development steps autonomously; request human input only for real scientific decisions, permissions, destructive actions, or ambiguous goals.

architectureDecisions.title: Headless runner is the batch-science interface
architectureDecisions.summary: Keynu should invoke Melakat's automated experiment system for sweeps and campaigns; the desktop GUI remains an observation and inspection tool.

architectureDecisions.title: MelakatDriver is domain-specific
architectureDecisions.summary: The driver validates/runs Melakat experiments and interprets Melakat artifacts while generic repository operations stay in Keynu Engineering Runtime.

architectureDecisions.title: Evidence remains in Melakat
architectureDecisions.summary: Keynu may reference and summarize campaign artifacts, but reproducible scientific outputs remain archived by the Melakat repository and its workflows.

architectureDecisions.title: Project roots are portable
architectureDecisions.summary: The default sibling root is '../melakat', while KEYNU_PROJECT_ROOT_MELAKAT can explicitly override it on machines with another repository layout.

knownLimitations: The default sibling project root '../melakat' is only a fallback; nonstandard layouts must set KEYNU_PROJECT_ROOT_MELAKAT before starting the mission runtime.
Keynu has not yet completed an end-to-end restart/resume test against Melakat.
Scientific interpretation still requires cautious causal analysis even when campaigns are automated.
